description: Oscillator that adds a sine at the pitch it is given to a second sine three hundred times higher, for a chirping tone

params.text: Sets how fast the upper tone is swept up and down, from a standstill at 0 to ten sweeps for every cycle of the pitch at 10; the sweep is one whole multiple of the pitch wide at any setting

inputs.text: Sets the pitch a volt per octave, with 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz, and is clamped at four octaves either side of that

outputs.text: The two tones added together, reaching 10V at the peaks

notes: the module sounds as soon as it is placed, at C4, with nothing patched into V/OCT
the upper tone is made at three hundred times the frequency set by V/OCT, which at ordinary pitches is above half the sample rate, so it arrives folded back into the audio range
the output swings to 10V, twice the ±5V that Rack's modules take as a full audio level

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V, giving C4.
